capabilities: Define rules that match notes by frontmatter property key or tag
Set left and right sidebar widths in pixels per matching note
Restore, reset, or keep sidebar width when no rule matches
Designate a fallback default width with a star button
extras: Desktop-only: mobile sidebars behave as overlays rather than fixed-width panes. The plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has a single global sidebar width, but some notes need a wide file explorer or right pane while others should stay compact.
summary: Sidebar width manager that sets the left and right sidebar widths per note using frontmatter property or tag rules.
